question: The Pitti Bird Sanctuary is located in which Union Territory/State of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Pitti Bird Sanctuary** is located in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India.
 
• The sanctuary is situated on **Pitti Island**, a small coral islet in Lakshadweep.
 
• Pitti Island is an important **nesting place for pelagic birds** such as the Sooty Tern, Nodd
